items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: them about the only three men that I knew.

ctx.x: He seemed to know everybody. Were there any other good trumpet players you can remember when you first moved up here, some of the oldest ones that were popular or that you thought were good?
Well outside of Manny Perez, and Joe Oliver, and Louis Armstrong, them about the only three men that I knew.
Which was the most popular band? Do you remember the most popular bands then? What the?
